title: Taichi printer core
objective: Build deterministic code emitter from ProblemIR + ElementIR + ContractionPlan producing Taichi source.
implementation_steps: Design printer API: emit(artifact_bundle) -> str (Taichi source)
Implement deterministic emission order for reproducible output
Implement function signature generation respecting JIT budget
Implement physics index → ti.static, mesh index → runtime loop partitioning
Write snapshot tests on emitted skeleton and key function signatures
acceptance_criteria: Emitted source is deterministic (same input → same output)
Physics indices use ti.static, mesh indices use runtime loops
Key function signatures match expected patterns

cases: Deterministic emission: two calls produce identical output
ti.init with f64 present in preamble
Index partitioning correct in emitted loops

risks: Taichi API changes between versions — pin taichi>=1.7
JIT budget compliance must be verified post-emission
